result.description: Compact portable storage device designed for field archiving, media transfer, and offline backup workflows. Uses USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 connectivity with an internal NVMe SSD and aluminum enclosure for ruggedized daily transport. Optimized for high-capacity sequential reads and writes rather than graphics, compute, or enterprise spinning-disk workloads.
result.title: Nebula Silt 2TB NVMe Portable Archive
